answer: Pay per place, not per account. Each epoch, 12 verifier nodes on different continents (assumed) ping agents at random times; light speed means round-trip times bound where each can be. Accounts in the same ~500 km cell split one emission seat, like a marble quarry paid per pit, not per block cut. A 1,000-clone rack in one data-center grove earns one seat; spreading means renting real machines in many cells. Padding delay fakes distance but looks slow, and so do honest bad links. Co-location isn't shared ownership: honest agents in one cloud region get squeezed and need an appeal trellis.
